rows.grounds: genitive plural of lokapāla, the directional guardian deities
genitive plural of tat-astra compound; tat refers to the world-guardians
conjunction linking the weapons with the guardians
action noun denoting ritual worship as part of the offerings

items.question: What additional objects of worship complete the sequence of ritual offerings?
premises: The ritual sequence includes arranged offerings up to flowers.
The world-guardians are included as recipients of worship.
The weapons of those world-guardians are also included.
items.inference: The ritual offerings are completed by worship of the world-guardians together with their weapons.
items.plain_english: And one should perform the worship of the world-guardians and of their weapons.
